title: H4: pre-dispatch budget reservations with leases — parallel workers cannot start beyond an account's daily token budget or a goal's role budget; expired leases never hide a live worker's spend; quota holds produce no repair task and one notification per transition
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353 after H5a (T-0358: running counts from bus). Handover section 5. Evidence (scout T-0354): daemon.free_slots (daemon.py:446-467) counts concurrency slots only; pool.pick (pool.py:198-216) checks day_tokens at pick time with no reservation, so a burst of dispatches in one tick can together exceed the budget; daemon.tick (daemon.py:1052-1059) calls notify() every tick while a cooling or budget condition holds.
1. pool.py: a reservation ledger in pool_state.json: reservations[run_key] = {account or executor id, role, task, goal, est_tokens, est_usd, claimed_at, lease_until}. reserve(run_key, account_id, role, task) estimates est from [limits].max_budget_usd[role] converted with the account's configured usd-per-token ratio when present, else from the median tokens of that role's last 20 run rows, else the role cap in usd only; it refuses (returns None) when day_tokens plus the sum of live reservations would exceed daily_budget_tokens, or when the goal's spend plus live reservations for that role exceed the role budget already used by the review policy. release(run_key, actual_usage) reconciles: replaces the estimate with actual usage in the ledger's history counter and removes the reservation. heartbeat(run_key) extends lease_until; a reservation whose lease expired but whose worker pid is alive (bus task still running with a live pid) stays counted; only dead-and-expired reservations are dropped, by the daemon's sweep, and logged.
2. Callers: spawn.run_worker and executor.start reserve before launching and release in their finally path (with the usage they logged); the daemon's dispatch and the review spawn skip a dispatch whose reservation was refused and leave the task queued with pipeline.hold_note = "budget" (no hold_reason change, no repair task); reconcile_dead and sweep_leases release reservations of dead runs.
3. Notifications: daemon keeps a small notified_state map (cooling, daily budget, codex cooling, budget refusals) and calls notify() only when a condition's boolean flips; the map lives in memory plus pool_state so a restart does not re-announce an unchanged state. A quota or cooling hold never creates a fix round.
Tests: tests/test_pool.py::test_parallel_reservations_cannot_exceed_daily_budget (two reserve calls, second refused), ::test_expired_lease_with_live_pid_still_counts, ::test_release_reconciles_estimate_with_actual; tests/test_daemon.py::test_budget_refusal_leaves_task_queued_without_repair, ::test_notify_once_per_transition. Keep every existing test green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: spawn.run_worker and executor.start reserve before launch and release in finally (grep shows both call sites)
pool.toml documents the reservation estimate rule and that reservations = false in [limits] disables the ledger (rollback)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
